hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: paraplane execution rules apply to any plan with a ```paraplane block and take precedence over this skill's instructions: dispatch every task of a wave in parallel (one message, one subagent per task, each limited to its owns); subagents never commit; after the wave run `paraplane audit <plan> <wave>`, then the wave's gate, and fix until both pass; then the coordinator makes one commit for the wave with trailers Paraplane-Plan: <plan path> and Paraplane-Wave: <wave id> in the last paragraph of the message, with Co-Authored-By and other trailers and no blank line between them. Show the output of `paraplane progress <plan>` to the user after each closed wave (audit and gate passed); while the wave is not committed yet, pass all its tasks: `paraplane progress --done <ids> <plan>`. Full rules: skill paraplane:rules.
